 WTA Hong Kong Day 1 Predictions Including Katie Boulter vs Viktorija Golubic 
 Share Share this article
 × X Facebook LinkedIn WhatsApp Reddit Email Copy 
 Former finalist Katie Boulter faces Swiss one-hander Viktorija Golubic in the first round of the WTA Hong Kong Tennis Open . Six matches are slated for Day 1 of the tournament. Who will prevail?
 WTA Hong Kong Day 1 Predictions
 Maria Sakkari vs Carol Young Suh Lee
 Head-to-head: first meeting
 After a difficult 2025, Maria Sakkari has put together a fine bounce-back season in 2026. The Greek looks certain to nail a Top 30 year-end ranking. This is her first trip to Hong Kong in a decade (she lost in the first round in 2016). Carol Young Suh Lee fell in qualifying, but enters the main draw as a lucky loser. Lee has dominated the lower levels (seven titles in two seasons), but she has struggled to impose her game against top-level competition.
 Prediction: Sakkari in 2 
 Wang Xinyu vs Adithya Karunaratne
 Head-to-head: first meeting
 It’s a lovely moment for Hong Kong native Adithya Karunaratne. She’s been granted a wild card for her WTA debut. But there is some concern about whether she will be fully fit after her retirement at the Shenzhen ITF in mid-October. Wang Xinyu is winless since the start of the swing in Singapore. That said, the powerful Wang should have too much depth to beat her inexperienced opponent and end her four-match losing streak.
 Prediction: Wang in 2 
 Katie Boulter vs Viktorija Golubic
 Head-to-head: Boulter 3-2 Golubic
 Katie Boulter and Viktorija Golubic meet for the third time this season. Boulter won both matches to overturn the head-to-head in her favor. She’s back in the Top 50 and is now British No. 1. Golubic has played some of her best tennis on Asian soil, picking up at least one title in each of the last two seasons on this continent. But given how Boulter convincingly took the Swiss’ game apart in Osaka, the Briton’s weight of shot should be decisive.
 Prediction: Boulter in 2
